review.rationale: Primary review of all 46 people on the official University of Kentucky ECE faculty, adjunct and emeritus category pages, reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit that read 13 profiles. 26 regular faculty and two joint-appointment professors are included; Rohan Reddy Kalavakonda is included on the Nelms Institute news page (22 September 2026) quoting him as a tenure-track Assistant Professor in ECE at Kentucky (project-owner determination dated 2026-11-25 as well). First-year-engineering lecturers, adjuncts and emeriti are excluded.
review.independent_review_scope: Full-roster independent audit of 46 directory entries.
